description: This file is a shell script used for managing Google Test (gtest) applications, including downloading, cleaning, and logging activities related to gtest apps in a build or deployment environment.

methods.name: echo_t
methods.description: Logs messages with a timestamp to the log file.

methods.name: clean_gtest_app
methods.description: Removes directories and unmounts the gtest application specified.

methods.name: download_all_gtest_apps
methods.description: Downloads all gtest applications listed in the manifest JSON file.
